similar_structure_different_function.interpretation: Similar raw family residual does not imply similar functional sensitivity; layer/activation/continuation geometry matters strongly.

same_family_residual_vs_function.interpretation: Within the same sensitive family, increasing Frobenius family residual by more than fivefold produces only a modest KL increase; structural residual is not a calibrated functional metric.

calibration_nll_can_mislead.interpretation: All three L15 Q/K perturbations improve NLL on this tiny fixed calibration set while producing material KL and top-1 changes. This is not quality improvement evidence and demonstrates why one calibration loss cannot be the sole admission metric.

promising_local_candidate.interpretation: This is the least sensitive tested Q/K family intervention on the fixed calibration distribution, but it is not yet codec-positive or benchmark-validated.

mlp_low_descriptor_not_free.interpretation: Only 3.24% of the T002 descriptor energy is removed, yet functional changes are material. Descriptor energy alone is not a safe removability criterion. These channels are not low in total parameter Frobenius energy, so this is not an ordinary low-weight-energy pruning claim.

local_rate_scale_note.interpretation: Even a functionally mild local rank-3 family move is globally tiny by itself. Practical compression requires repeated reuse, broader quotients, or other dominant-structure solutions.

next_experiment.goal: Separate local activation-weighted sensitivity from downstream continuation amplification across many GQA groups.
next_experiment.priority_question: Why do structurally similar L15 and L29 rank-3 interventions differ by about 21.5x in KL?
